Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: one finished square Steam Workshop mod cover for 蘇清的音乐专辑. Reference image 1 is the ONLY character identity authority, the user's original adult silver-white dragon woman. Reference images 2 and 3 are style/layout authorities only: match their detailed crisp anime/pixel hybrid, warm amber/purple lighting and embroidered purple/gold title plaque. Do not copy their apron, pump, or trading props.
Depict exactly the same adult woman, same delicate face/proportions, lavender eyes, long flowing silver-white hair, white rosette/tassel ornament, paired ridged light dragon horns, pale lavender membrane wings, long white SCALED dragon tail. Keep her recognizable white/lavender embroidered dress; relaxed seated listening pose in a cozy dusk wooden music room, wearing wired over-ear headphones connected to a small vintage cassette Walkman. A black vinyl record with lavender label and neatly stacked cassette albums on the desk clearly communicate multi-song albums. Show a corner of a turntable but no loudspeaker. Purple dusk through window, amber lamp, gentle smile; no blue spirit necessary. Hands anatomically natural, moderate waist-up/three-quarter framing with visible tail curving beside chair and wing edges. Character dominates upper 70%.
Bottom 28% ornate deep purple embroidered rectangular title plaque with gold/lavender border, floral motifs and restrained music-note motifs, in exactly the same brand style as references 2/3. Exact large Chinese text in TWO lines:
蘇清的
音乐专辑
Small centered line below: SINGLE PLAYER
Keep all lettering accurate, readable and inside safe margins. Rich warm wood, lavender shadows, crisp refined illustration; opaque square artwork at high resolution. No game version, no mod version, no numerical text, no Build/B42, no watermark, no logos, no extra people, no weapons. Do not add extra horns/wings/tails.
